recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. The dedicated modifier section already conveys the required behavior; duplicating the full explanation in the later string-type summary would be editorial and risks maintenance drift.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core search issue for STU3 asking the :exact modifier to say exact matching includes casing and combining characters, while extended grapheme cluster and canonical-equivalence handling remains at server discretion.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 14261, represented by git commit 2f6cb4b8fee23dac83c8021e22b04f93ac8f25f1, which added the grapheme-cluster and canonically-equivalent-character discretion text to source/search.html.
additional_context: FHIR-16016 is the same change family and clarified default string search handling of combining characters in the immediately preceding revision. Later search-modifier documentation edits reorganized source/search.html and preserved the FHIR-16017 behavior in the dedicated exact modifier section. The originating Zulip thread supports server discretion, and Jira/Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/search.html currently says :exact input is the complete exact value tested for a match, including casing and combining characters, and that the server decides whether matching uses canonically equivalent characters or actual Unicode code points.

related_jiras.note: Parallel Published/Persuasive issue clarifying that default string search ignores included combining characters; audited opportunistically in this run.
